about_the_game:
Notoris 2 is a 2.5D single-player grand strategy inspired by Romance of the Three Kingdoms, where legendary generals forge rivalries and alliances in an open-ended sandbox shaped by your tactical choices and turn-based battles.

Rise From Officer to Legend

Experience the depth of classic grand strategy through the eyes of a single officer, rising from a lowly lieutenant to trusted administrator and beyond. Earn influence through cunning proposals and battlefield valor as you carve your own path to leadership.

Revolutionary Influence System

Your officers aren't puppets, they're ambitious individuals with their own goals. The groundbreaking Influence System gives you control over how much autonomy your subordinates have:

High Influence: Officers follow your vision precisely 

Low Influence: Officers act independently, pursuing their own strategies and allegiances

Dynamic Balance: Find the sweet spot between control and chaos

Influence isn't just flavor, it's a core mechanic that solves an age old strategy game problem giving players meaningful agency without turning AI into mindless automatons or brainless slaves.

Live As An Officer

✦ Submit proposals to shape your faction's destiny

✦ Take on civil assignments to build your reputation

✦ Forge alliances, rivalries, and betrayals with hundreds of unique officers

✦ Rise through the ranks or scheme your way to independence

Command As A Tactician

✦ Deploy armies on grid based battlefields where terrain and positioning decide victory

✦ Execute devastating officer abilities that can turn the tide of war

✦ Siege cities, cut supply lines, and outmaneuver your enemies

✦ Every battle matters. Lose your best generals as captives and feel the consequences

Rule As A Sovereign 

✦ Transform from loyal retainer to rebel warlord to emperor

✦ Manage cities, assign officers, and balance the needs of your growing realm

✦ Navigate a web of influence where even your subordinates pursue their own ambitions

✦ Watch the campaign map evolve as others rise and fall around you

Dark Fantasy Meets Historical Drama

Escape the constraints of strict history and enter a world where:

✦ Dark fantasy aesthetics meet the political intrigue of the Three Kingdoms era

✦ History’s iconic rivalries and betrayals reemerge as timeless character arcs

✦ A new era of possibility where interpersonal dramas play out in unexpected ways, shaped by your hand.

Crafted By Generals, For Generals

This is a passion project from a solo developer who grew up on Three Kingdoms games and is supported by a small team of part-time contractors that share the vision.

I'm attempting to bring together the best features from across 3k's history -- the deep officer roleplay that blended RPG into grand strategy like nothing before or since, and the tactical grid combat that always felt so close to greatness but never quite reached it. By fusing these elements and many others together, I'm hoping to create the definitive experience that fans have been waiting decades for. Your support means everything to a tiny indie project attempting to punch above it's weight class.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad Core 3.2GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 770 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 24 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad Core 3.4GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1080 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 24 GB available space

short_description: A dark meets high fantasy strategy RPG inspired by the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. Play as ruler, administrator, or officer, wielding Influence to sway allies and rivals alike. Command vast armies in tense tactical turn-based battles.
supported_languages:
English*, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese
*languages with full audio support
